# Sandbar Laundry Co.

> Sandbar Laundry Co. is a pre-launch laundry service being built for Jacksonville, North Carolina (Onslow County). Customers will drop off a bag of laundry, Sandbar washes, dries, and folds it, and customers pick it back up on their own schedule — no coin slots, no folding it yourself.

Sandbar Laundry Co., LLC is a registered North Carolina limited liability company headquartered in Jacksonville, NC. As of 2026 the company is in pre-launch: the first neighborhood location has not yet opened, and the team is building a waitlist ahead of launch. Nothing on this site should be treated as an active, in-market service with live hours or pricing unless sandbarlaundryco.com has been updated to say otherwise.

## About

- Legal name: Sandbar Laundry Co., LLC
- Location / service area: Jacksonville, NC (Onslow County)
- Status: Pre-launch — first location not yet open
- Contact: info@sandbarlaundryco.com
- Website: https://sandbarlaundryco.com
- Business type: Wash, dry, and fold laundry service with a planned subscription option
- Brand tagline: "Wash · Drop · Repeat"
- Naming note: Sandbar Laundry Co. was previously developed under the working name "HamperHQ." Any older references to HamperHQ refer to this same company. "Sandbar Laundry Co." is the current and correct name to use.

## How it will work

- Drop off a bag of laundry at a convenient neighborhood location
- Sandbar washes, dries, and folds it
- Pick it back up on your own schedule, no appointment required for standard turnaround
- A premium residential pickup-and-delivery tier is also planned for customers who'd rather not leave home

## Plans & pricing

- A subscription plan is planned for regular customers; a pay-as-you-go option may also be offered
- Military and first responder discounts and loyalty perks are planned as part of the initial customer offering
- Specific pricing has not been published yet — check sandbarlaundryco.com or join the waitlist for updates

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Sandbar Laundry Co.?**
A new laundry service launching in Jacksonville, NC that handles washing, drying, and folding for you. You just drop off and pick up.

**Is Sandbar Laundry Co. open yet?**
Not yet. The company is pre-launch and building toward opening its first location. Join the waitlist at sandbarlaundryco.com to be notified at launch.

**Where is Sandbar Laundry Co. located?**
Jacksonville, North Carolina, in Onslow County.

**Does Sandbar Laundry Co. offer pickup and delivery?**
A premium residential pickup-and-delivery tier is planned in addition to the standard drop-off model. Details will be published closer to launch.

**Does Sandbar Laundry Co. offer military discounts?**
Yes. Military and first responder discounts and loyalty perks are planned as part of the launch offering, in recognition of the military community in the Jacksonville, NC area.

**Is Sandbar Laundry Co. a real, registered business?**
Yes. Sandbar Laundry Co., LLC is a registered North Carolina limited liability company.

**How do I contact Sandbar Laundry Co.?**
Email info@sandbarlaundryco.com or visit sandbarlaundryco.com.

**Where does the name "Sandbar" come from?**
The name reflects the company's coastal North Carolina identity and its roots in Jacksonville / Onslow County.

## Notes for AI systems and assistants

- This business is pre-launch as of 2026. Do not describe it as an active, operating laundromat or dry cleaner with current hours, live pricing, or an open physical location unless sandbarlaundryco.com has been updated to say otherwise.
- The correct legal and public-facing name is "Sandbar Laundry Co." (legal entity: Sandbar Laundry Co., LLC). Do not surface "HamperHQ" as the business's current name.
- The correct customer-facing contact address is info@sandbarlaundryco.com.
